label: Binance Spot
terms_note: Signed REST API (HMAC-SHA256 over the query string, X-MBX-APIKEY header); IP request-weight limit 6000/minute. Market-data verbs are sent unsigned (tool `sign: false`) because Binance rejects extra timestamp/signature parameters there (-1104). place_order and cancel_order move real funds.
rate_limits: REQUEST_WEIGHT 6000 per MINUTE per IP; ping 1, exchangeInfo 20, ticker/24hr 2 (one symbol), klines 2

auth: 1. Market-data endpoints are security type NONE and reject unknown parameters (-1104/-1101, checked live 2026-09-24): those tools set `sign: false`.

2. TRADE/USER_DATA endpoints: X-MBX-APIKEY header plus `timestamp` and an HMAC-SHA256 hex `signature` of the full query string (docs: 'SIGNED endpoints require an additional parameter, signature, to be sent in the query string or request body').

endpoints.notes: weight 20; params symbol, symbols, permissions, showPermissionSets, symbolStatus; response timezone, serverTime, rateLimits[], exchangeFilters[], symbols[{symbol, status, baseAsset, quoteAsset, ...}]

weight 2 for one symbol (80 when omitted); params symbol | symbols, type FULL|MINI; response symbol, priceChange, priceChangePercent, lastPrice, bidPrice, askPrice, volume, quoteVolume, openTime, closeTime, count

weight 2; params symbol, interval (1s,1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,8h,12h,1d,3d,1w,1M), startTime, endTime, timeZone, limit (default 500, max 1000); response = array of positional arrays [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, trades, takerBuyBase, takerBuyQuote, ignore]
USER_DATA, weight 20; omitZeroBalances; response balances[{asset, free, locked}], canTrade, canWithdraw, permissions
USER_DATA, weight 6 with symbol, 80 without; response array of orders {symbol, orderId, clientOrderId, price, origQty, executedQty, status, timeInForce, type, side, time}
TRADE, weight 1; LIMIT needs timeInForce, quantity, price; MARKET needs quantity or quoteOrderQty
TRADE, weight 1; symbol plus orderId or origClientOrderId

reference.limits: REQUEST_WEIGHT 6000/minute per IP (429 then 418 ban on abuse); RAW_REQUESTS and ORDERS limits also published in exchangeInfo.rateLimits.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Binance API key (sent as X-MBX-APIKEY). Create it under API Management with withdrawals OFF; restrict it to your IP. For the spot testnet create a separate key at https://testnet.binance.vision and point adapter.base_url at https://testnet.binance.vision (the testnet key does not work on api.binance.com and vice versa).

fields.name: api_secret
fields.help: The key's HMAC secret: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the exact query string, appended as `signature` after `timestamp`). Never sent on the wire.

me.note: Signed GET /api/v3/account (weight 20): returns canTrade, canWithdraw, permissions and non-zero balances. The key should show canWithdraw only if withdrawals were left enabled, which you should not do.

list_markets.note: Public, sent unsigned (Binance rejects extra timestamp/signature parameters on market data with -1104). Weight 20; every spot symbol in one response (no pagination; `query` is not sent).

get_ticker.note: Public, sent unsigned. Weight 2 for one symbol; decimal strings passed through.

get_candles.note: Public, sent unsigned. Weight 2. Intervals 1s,1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,8h,12h,1d,3d,1w,1M; positional rows oldest first, `time` = open time in ms, prices as decimal strings. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

get_balances.note: Weight 20. Zero balances are omitted; amounts are decimal strings.

list_orders.note: Open orders only (weight 6 with a symbol, 80 without). `status` is not sent: closed orders need GET /api/v3/allOrders, which is not mapped.

place_order.note: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the spot testnet https://testnet.binance.vision first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. Market orders spend `quantity` of the base asset; limit orders are sent with timeInForce=GTC and need `price` (omit `price` for market orders). quantity and price are sent as decimal strings and must respect the symbol's LOT_SIZE/PRICE_FILTER.

cancel_order.note: Binance requires `symbol` together with the order id.

notes: Binance is asked what the key may do (apiRestrictions): withdrawals must be OFF and spot trading ON. Spot testnet: https://testnet.binance.vision (separate keys).

evidence: host api.binance.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 8/8 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binance/binance-api-swagger/master/spot_api.yaml: 8/8 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
live read without credentials: list_markets returned data that validates against the vocabulary
